# ShortClipr

> ShortClipr is a web-based creative studio that turns a written idea or prompt into a finished 15- to 60-second animated short video with illustrated scenes, voiceover narration, and final assembly.

## Current product facts

- A creator starts with a topic, question, story, or creative brief.
- ShortClipr creates animated scenes, narration, visual direction, and final assembly for the short.
- Creators can choose supported voice, visual direction, duration, and aspect ratio before creating a video.
- Paid plans support 15-, 30-, 45-, and 60-second shorts in 9:16, 1:1, and 16:9 formats.
- The free plan includes one finished 15-second short each month.
- Creators review and download the finished MP4; ShortClipr does not automatically publish to third-party social platforms.
- ShortClipr is not a YouTube clipping, podcast repurposing, or long-video-to-shorts product.

## Primary product pages

- [AI animated video maker](https://shortclipr.com/story-machine/): the main product and creative workflow.
- [AI animated video generator](https://shortclipr.com/ai-animated-video-generator/): complete 15–60s narrated animated shorts from a brief.
- [Prompt to video](https://shortclipr.com/prompt-to-video/): turn structured text prompts into multi-scene animated videos.
- [Text to animation](https://shortclipr.com/text-to-animation/): turn a written prompt into an animated video.
- [AI short video generator](https://shortclipr.com/ai-short-video-generator/): original 15s–60s animated shorts for Shorts, TikTok, and Reels.
- [AI cartoon video maker](https://shortclipr.com/ai-cartoon-video-maker/): stylized cartoon shorts and character fables from text.
- [Animated map video maker](https://shortclipr.com/animated-map-video-maker/): historical trade routes, geography, and journey animations.
- [Faceless video maker](https://shortclipr.com/faceless-video-maker/): create videos without appearing on camera.
- [Faceless AI shorts generator](https://shortclipr.com/faceless-ai-shorts-generator/): prompt-led faceless shorts with human review.
- [Animated explainer video maker](https://shortclipr.com/animated-explainer-video-maker/): explain a complex topic visually.
- [Educational animated video maker](https://shortclipr.com/educational-video-maker/): teach a focused concept.
- [AI quiz video maker](https://shortclipr.com/video-quiz-maker/): create question, pause, reveal, and explanation videos.
- [Animated story video maker](https://shortclipr.com/animated-story-video-maker/): create a compact animated narrative.
